name: Masala Chai
about: An Indian black tea blend mixed with spices. It is a classic taste of Mumbai's everyday tea culture.
tip: Black tea without milk is sold as a separate choice, so pick the blend you want before buying.

name: Kolhapuri Sandals
about: A traditional leather sandal from Maharashtra, the state Mumbai belongs to. They are handmade and known for their durable craft.
tip: Check that they are handmade and made of leather before you pay.
